scope: One full-resolution YCbCr color-row primitive; two frozen JPEG inputs from one original 513x259 raster. Single CPU warm public decode to independent RGBA8. No uniform parity claim.
changedPrimitive: Full-resolution YCbCr render rows only: safe AVX2 widens eight byte samples per plane, subtracts exact integer chroma offsets, and AVX-512F/VL preserves every separate original binary64 color operation and byte rounding. Reuse 24 bytes of the existing inverse-block scratch for three rounded channels and safely interleave eight RGBA pixels. Full-resolution equal component factors only, including common 1x2 factors. Original row tails, subsampled interpolation, grayscale, explicit RGB and non-SIMD production paths remain. No new buffer, table, cache, heap allocation, working-byte admission or logical work. Original pixels, geometry/orientation, entropy/error order, limits, cancellation and independent output ownership remain.

baseline.boundary: Identical resident prepared 8-bit 4:4:4 JPEG to independent owned RGBA8. Public managed Decode, allocation and disposal; native software mjpeg decoder, per-operation state reset, full-range BT.601 conversion, owned output allocation and release. Native context/conversion/input packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes and converts all pixels. Padded native rows are exposed without a gratuitous packing copy. Startup, I/O, IPC, generation, hashing, checks and tight-row file writes excluded. No encoder quality search or additional source raster. Decoder RGB maximum 4/RMSE 1.5, exact opaque alpha.

baselineAttribution.attributionRule: Match method names before the first parenthesis; parameter type names do not count as method frames. coefficientEntropyGroup is the union of ReadBlock, entropy-reader and Huffman stacks, not one primitive.
